allowedDomains.title: Allowed email domains
allowedDomains.description: Account domains that are NOT flagged, e.g. example.com

reportEndpoint.title: Report endpoint
reportEndpoint.description: HTTPS URL that receives flag events as JSON POST

deviceIdentifier.title: Device identifier
deviceIdentifier.description: Value the MDM stamps in so flags can be attributed to a device or enrolled user

authToken.title: Auth token
authToken.description: Bearer token sent to the report endpoint: the receiver's shared AUTH_TOKEN, or an enrollment token (aige_...) from a managed-mode receiver, which this browser profile exchanges once for its own device credential

pasteGuardMode.title: Paste guard mode
pasteGuardMode.description: off, warn (intercept with a paste-anyway override), or block. Unset behaves as warn.

classificationMarkings.title: Classification markings
classificationMarkings.description: Document classification labels the paste guard flags, matched case-insensitively as phrases (e.g. Client Confidential). Bare CONFIDENTIAL in caps is always flagged. Unset uses the built-in defaults in guard.js.
